question: can GLM-5.3-flash run layer/row-split across R9700 + Strix iGPU in llama.cpp?
result: NO on current master - the CUDA backend does not implement ggml_backend_split_buffer_type at all (0 references in ggml-cuda.cu; only SYCL and Hexagon backends implement it). llama.cpp throws device ROCm0 does not support split buffers with -sm row or -sm layer regardless of tensor-split ratios or -ngl.
also: -sm none with -ngl 99 tries to fit the whole 101 GiB Q2_K_XL in the R9700 32 GB and OOMs; -ngl 0 (CPU) works but is 6.95 tok/s.
